title: 00. CSS Native
content:
#roadmap 

### Pembuka:
1. [Pengenalan Css native](01.%20Pengenalan%20CSS%20Native.md)
2. [Aturan Styling](02.%20Aturan%20Styling.md)
3. [Melampirkan Styling pada Dokumen HTML](03.%20Melampirkan%20Styling%20pada%20Dokumen%20HTML.md)
4. [CSS Conception](04.%20CSS%20Conception.md)

### Pendalaman Komponen & Styling:
1. [Selector](05.%20Selector.md)
2. [Pseudo Selector](06.%20Pseudo%20Selector.md)
3. [Font Styling](07.%20Font%20Styling.md)
4. [Text Styling](08.%20Text%20Styling.md)
5. [Pewarnaan](09.%20Pewarnaan.md)
6. [Box Model](10.%20Box%20Model.md)
7. [Box Shadow](11.%20Box%20Shadow.md)
8. [Display role](12.%20Display%20Role.md)
9. [Rounded Corner](13.%20Rounded%20Corner.md)
10. [Positioning](14.%20Positioning.md)
11. [Floating](15.%20Floating.md)
12. [Konfigurasi Meta Tag Viewport untuk Responsivitas Layout](16.%20Konfigurasi%20Meta%20Tag%20Viewport%20untuk%20Responsivitas%20Layout.md)

### Tata Letak Fleksibel & Responsif:
1. [Flexbox](17.%20Flexbox.md)

---

### Proyek Praktek Langsung (Hands-on Labs):
Setiap proyek dilengkapi berkas `index.html` dan `styles.css` yang siap dibuka langsung di browser untuk latihan mandiri:

1. [Praktek 01: Profile Card Modern](praktek/01-profile-card/index.html) : Latihan Box Model, Border-radius, Box-shadow bertingkat, dan Avatar.
2. [Praktek 02: Navbar & Dropdown Menu](praktek/02-navbar-dropdown/index.html) : Latihan Fixed Navbar, pola Parent Relative + Child Absolute, dan menu dropdown interaktif.
3. [Praktek 03: Flexbox Dashboard Cards](praktek/03-flexbox-dashboard-cards/index.html) : Latihan menyusun kartu dashboard statistik responsif dengan `display: flex`, `gap`, dan `flex-wrap`.
4. [Praktek 04: Modern Pricing Table](praktek/04-pricing-table/index.html) : Latihan kartu perbandingan harga dengan ribbon badge melayang, hover elevation, dan tombol kapsul.
